claims.statement: OpenJev-ModernBERT achieves 96.0% accuracy on restricted 5-candidate Banking77 evaluation (1 gold intent + 3 random distractors + abstention).
Fine-tuning reduces multiclass Brier score from 0.6534 to 0.0719 on the restricted 5-candidate test set.
Post-hoc temperature scaling (T=2.0449) achieves equal-width ECE of 0.0201 (2.01%) on the restricted 5-candidate test set.
When the true intent is removed from Banking77 candidate sets, the model abstains on 16 of 77 diagnostic cases (20.78%), falsely accepting a distractor on 61 cases.
Evaluating all 77 Banking77 intents plus abstention in a single pass is supported.
claims.reason: Model head output dimension is fixed at 25 logits. Target 76 produces IndexError.

claims.statement: Browser demo executes real local inference at 15ms via WebGPU.
claims.note: Commit fa70460 contained a simulated setTimeout(15) demo with pre-scripted outputs. Replaced in G6 with real in-browser ONNX Runtime Web worker execution.

claims.statement: Real in-browser warm inference latency target of p50 <= 30ms on Apple Silicon M-series via WebGPU.
OpenJev-ModernBERT v2 retrained on decontaminated data achieves 70.5% abstention recall on the missing-option challenge slice (200 cases), an increase from 9.0% on the baseline checkpoint.
OpenJev-ModernBERT v2 achieves 95.5% abstention recall on the distant out-of-scope challenge slice (200 CLINC cases).
OpenJev-ModernBERT v2 achieves 93.5% top-1 accuracy, 0.0940 multiclass Brier score, and 0.2038 NLL on decontaminated held-out Banking77 test set (1,000 cases).
Exported ONNX Runtime model executes CPU inference in 21.46ms on Apple Silicon M4 with max absolute difference of 1.05e-5 against native PyTorch.
